segments.text:
V. 25
He knew her not, till after ſhe baa brought forth—It cannot be inferred from hence, that he knew her afterward: No more than it can be inferred from that Expreſſion (2 Sam. vi. 23.) Michal had no Child till the day of her Death, that ſhe had Children afterward. Nor do the Words that follow, the firſt-born Son, alter the Caſe. For there are Abundance of Places, wherein the Term firſt-born is uſed, tho' there were no ſubſequent Children.
